content:
Donald Trump drew backlash this weekend after sharing a photograph of himself with Russian President Vladimir Putin, which he captioned: “My friend.”

It showed him shaking hands with and appearing to whisper into Putin’s ear during their meeting last week at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China.

The caption echoed Trump’s greeting of Putin at the event.

That moment sparked outrage, given how Putin is accused of war crimes over Russia’s ongoing invasion of Ukraine, and because Russia is also a close ally of Iran, against which Trump launched an ongoing war in February.

“All kidding aside, this may be one of the most disturbing, evil things, a @POTUS has ever said or ‘posted.’ Simply, beyond belief,” wrote Luis Moreno, a former U.S. ambassador to Jamaica.
